• Experience with synthetic security fixtures and deterministic testing approaches is highly desirable.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
About AMMP
AMMP builds software for the renewable energy sector: AMMP OS, the operating system for renewable energy portfolios. Developers, EPCs, asset owners, O&M providers and finance teams use it to monitor, operate and report on their sites. It connects 30+ inverter, battery and meter brands and covers 10,000+ sites in 35+ countries, many of them multi-vendor fleets.
We build the product with our customers, and their day-to-day problems set the roadmap (a missed outage, a savings report that takes a week to compile). In 2026 we launched Ray, an AI coworker that sits in Teams or Slack and answers questions about a customer's fleet in plain language. We're a small team, working remotely.
What you'll do
Onboarding (roughly 40% of your time)

• Run kickoff calls and collect what we need from each customer: site lists, vendor API credentials, PV orientation, target yield from PVsyst or Helioscope.

• Set up new organisations and assets in AMMP OS; connect vendor APIs, and data source selection.

• Configure and manage AMMP OS platform tailored to the customer's operation

• Test end to end before handover, then invite users and set their permissions.

• Work closely with other teams including but not limited to Software and Product Team.

Adoption and account health

• Track feature adoption and a health score for each account; we have a framework drafted and need someone to run it.

• Run quarterly check-ins with key accounts. Train users when adoption drops below target.

• Spot expansion: more MWp, an added module, Ray, the Data API.

Support

• Be the first point of contact.

• Triage data gaps, missing telemetry and billing questions; use our AI agents for first-line investigation and escalate the rest.

Renewals and feedback

• Feed recurring customer requests into the product backlog, with a clear write-up of who asked and why.

• Help us make onboarding faster. Today a 6-vendor customer takes about 10 hours of asset setup plus 20 hours of dashboard work; we want that number to fall.

What you'll bring
Must-haves

• 3+ years in customer success, technical account management or solutions engineering at a B2B SaaS company.

• Comfort with data. You can read an API response, write a basic SQL query, and spot when a number looks wrong.

• Clear written English; you'll write to customers in 35+ countries.

• You finish things. Onboarding has a lot of small steps, and missing one breaks the customer's first impression.

Nice-to-haves

• Experience with battery storage, gensets or hybrid systems.

• Working knowledge of solar PV: you know what an inverter, PR and yield are, and why a site underperforms.

• Grafana, Looker Studio or a similar BI tool.

• Python or Jupyter notebooks for small data jobs.

• Familiarity with inverter portals.

• Experience in emerging markets, especially sub-Saharan Africa or Latin America.

• French, Portuguese or Spanish.

What we offer

• A real say in how customer success works here; you'd be building the playbook, not following one.

• Work that cuts emissions: every site we monitor is solar or storage replacing diesel or grid power.

• A team that already uses AI agents in daily work, so you spend less time on copy-paste setup.

• Remote work and flexible hours.

• Salary: EUR 15,000-25,000/year

title: Senior Security Engineer - US
description:
Senior Security Engineer - US
About VulnCheck
Exploitation prevention is only as strong as the intelligence driving those efforts, and most of the industry is still running on intelligence that lacks exploit context. VulnCheck, The Exploit Intelligence Company, delivers structured exploit intelligence on what is actively weaponized in the wild, purpose-built for the data lakes, ETL pipelines, automation, and AI and LLM workflows your infrastructure already runs on, raising the capability of everything it powers.
About the Role
We're hiring a Senior Security Engineer to work side-by-side with our engineering team, embedding security into how we build and ship - not bolting it on after the fact. You'll partner with engineers on design reviews, help harden the platform as it grows, and build the tooling and automation that lets security scale without slowing anyone down. You'll report to our VP of Information Security and have real autonomy to identify problems and build the solutions yourself and in collaboration with engineering.
This is a builder's role. In addition to use of vendor tools, you'll be writing code and infrastructure that turns security and compliance work into repeatable, self-service processes for the business helping to automate and improve what's manual today, closing gaps in how we detect and respond to issues, and giving engineering the guardrails and feedback loops they need to move fast safely.
What You'll Do
Partner with Engineering on Platform Security

• Work directly with engineering on design and architecture reviews, threat modeling, and secure-by-default patterns for new services

• Review and harden IaC across our cloud environments (EKS, Aurora, OpenSearch, S3, IAM)

• Lead least-privilege IAM decomposition and drive adoption of stronger identity patterns across the platform

• Support disaster recovery testing and resilience exercises alongside the infrastructure team

Build Tooling That Scales Security

• Design and build automation that turns detection, response, and compliance work into repeatable processes rather than manual effort

• Improve and extend onboarding/offboarding automation, alert triage pipelines, and identity/access anomaly detection

• Build internal tools that give engineering fast, self-service ways to check their own security posture

What You’ll Bring

• 5+ years in security engineering, with real depth in AWS security and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Terragrunt strongly preferred)

• Firm working knowledge of Kubernetes/EKS security - RBAC, network policies, pod security standards, image scanning, and cluster hardening

• Strong written communication - you'll document your own work, since we're a small, high-trust team

• A track record of building tools or automation that solved a security problem at scale, not just running existing tools

• Previous use of tools like Crowdstrike, Wiz, Security Hub

• Experience with golang

• Comfortable working directly with software engineers - in code reviews, design discussions, and incident response

• Incident investigation and RCA tracking

• Experience supporting a SOC 2 (or similar framework) program from the technical/evidence side

• Experience with Google Workspace as an identity/IdP source of truth

• Self-directed: you'll often be the only engineer working a problem end to end

Preferred Qualifications

• Exposure to offensive security or red/purple teaming

• Familiarity with Aurora or managed OpenSearch specifically

What We Offer
We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted, and valued. VulnCheck offers benefits designed to meet a wide range of needs and lifestyles, tailored to your country of employment:

• Generous, flexible time off

• Retirement/pension plan contributions (e.g., 401k with match in the US; local pension schemes elsewhere)

• Comprehensive healthcare coverage

• Generous paid parental leave

• Remote-friendly environment with flexibility

• Support for home office costs

Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.
This role sits in Zyte 's Tooling team, working side by side with our Principal Engineer in Tooling on an internal agentic platform: one place that brings together what the company knows, today spread across many systems, so that people and their AI agents get that context in one place, each seeing only what they are allowed to see.
We are looking for a builder: someone who has built AI agents and shipped them to real users, and who likes owning a product end to end, from talking with the people who use it to the code, the deployment and the numbers that say whether it works. The first version is already in use inside the company and grows every week.
Roles & Responsibilities:

• Build the platform with the Principal Engineer in Tooling: new capabilities every week, from design to production.

• Connect new internal systems and SaaS tools to the platform: their APIs and data, how they fit a shared model, and who may see what.

• Build agents and the tools they use, including MCP servers that agents across the company can call, and the context they need to answer well.

• Own quality: evaluation sets and benchmarks, tracing, cost per answer, and fixing what users run into.

• Turn proofs of concept into internal tools that run in production in the cloud, with security and access done properly.

• Build with AI coding agents as the main way of working, with the specs, tests and reviews that keep the code sound.

• Contribute to company-wide AI tooling initiatives: evaluating and standardising internal AI tools, cost and usage tracking, and agreed standards for AI-built internal apps; help other teams build on the platform.

• Talk with the people who use the platform, across the company, to learn what to build next, and explain what was built to technical and non-technical audiences.

Requirements

• 3+ years building and shipping production software, mostly in Python, with relational databases.

• Has built and shipped with LangGraph at least one agent that real people use: tool calling, retrieval and embeddings, prompt and context design.

• Hands-on experience with LLM APIs from the main providers, cost and token optimisation.

• Hands-on with MCP or similar tool protocols, as a server and as a client.

• Evaluates AI systems properly: test sets, LLM-as-judge, regressions when a prompt or a model changes; tracing and observability with Langfuse or similar.

• Integrates APIs and data: SaaS APIs, SQL, data warehouses.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure (Google Cloud and/or AWS): containers, managed databases, identity and access, CI/CD.

• Uses AI coding agents every day and knows how to keep their output in check.

• A sense for security and permissions: identity, least privilege, people see only what they are allowed to see.

• Comfortable with version control (GitHub/Bitbucket).

• Excellent written and spoken English, technical and non-technical.

Desired Skills:

• Familiarity with web data or web scraping.

• Django and Postgres, including vector search with pgvector.

• Enough frontend to build and change a chat interface (React, Next.js).

• Has built internal tools that colleagues adopted

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

We are investing in our owned social channels to grow share of voice and tell a clearer, more connected company story across LinkedIn, X, Instagram and YouTube. We need someone to take direct ownership of X and run it day to day, while also maintaining consistent social performance data analysis across all of our owned channels.

This is a hands-on social strategy role for someone who knows how to build an interesting, credible and active presence on X. You will also work with the Social Manager to turn channel and audience data into clear recommendations about what Harvey should create, publish, test, stop and scale. The goal is a steady feedback loop between how our audience behaves, what our content strategy is and how our creative gets made.

- Support founder, executive and employee amplification where it makes sense.

- Track changes to X and adjust our approach as the platform evolves.

- Work with Social Manager and Social Content and Community Manager to pull weekly and monthly performance analysis across X, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

- Collaborate with the social team to go beyond surface metrics and explain what actually drove performance.

- Identify patterns across format, topic, audience, timing, creative approach and distribution.

- Help turn findings into specific programming and creative recommendations.

- Work with third party analytics tools to track follower growth, reach, engagement, clicks, sentiment and other channel-specific signals.

- Analyze performance during major launches, events and campaigns utilizing third party analytics and channel analytics.

Translate canonical semantic definitions into:

• Physical data models

• Schemas

• Pipelines

Ensure all data structures conform to:

• Enterprise standards

• Platform contracts

Additional Job Responsibilities

Define data interfaces required by:

• Internal AI teams

• External model providers

Support:

• Model versioning

• Feature compatibility

• Performance validation

5. Design for Multi-Tenant and Product Use Cases

Ensure data pipelines and access patterns support multi-tenant environments, including:

• Customer data isolation and secure access controls

• Scalable onboarding of new tenants and use cases

• Reuse of data pipelines across customers and deployments

Note: The underlying data model for multi-tenancy is governed by the Principal Manufacturing & Semantic Architect.

Partner with:

• Principal Manufacturing & Semantic Architect (canonical model definition and feature semantics)

About the role
FronteraCare is seeking an experienced Recruiter to own and scale our Registered Behavior Technician hiring across our existing markets. Few workflows in our business have as direct a line to patient care as RBT recruiting: every RBT hired is a child who can start or continue therapy, which makes this one of the most impactful roles at FronteraCare. This is a high-volume role for someone who has already built strong recruiting instincts and is ready to take a program that's up and running and push it further, improving speed, quality, and consistency as we grow. You'll travel to New Mexico periodically to stay close to the market and the teams you're hiring for.

You'll report to the Talent Lead and work alongside a Recruiter focused on emerging markets, with this role dedicated specifically to owning full-cycle recruiting for BT and RBT roles in FronteraCare's established markets. This is a great fit for someone who thrives in high-volume, fast-moving recruiting environments, finds genuine reward in the grind of consistent high-volume hiring, and brings both process discipline and compassion to every candidate interaction.

What is ABA?
Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) is a therapy that uses evidence-based techniques to help children with autism build communication, social, and daily living skills. Care is typically delivered one-on-one by Behavior Technicians and Registered Behavior Technicians under the guidance of a licensed Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA), with progress tracked closely so each child's plan can be adjusted as they grow.

What you'll do

• Own full cycle recruiting for BT and RBT roles across FronteraCare's existing markets, from sourcing and screening through offer and onboarding handoff

• Take ownership of established sourcing channels and candidate pipelines, refining and scaling what's already working rather than building from scratch

• Maintain a high, consistent volume of active requisitions, balancing speed with quality in a fast-moving, high-turnover talent pool

• Travel to New Mexico periodically to build local candidate and community relationships and stay close to market conditions

• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, clinical leaders, BCBAs, and current RBTs to stay close to market needs, referral opportunities, and what makes candidates want to join and stay

• Support additional recruiting projects and initiatives as needed to help the team meet its hiring goals

What you'll bring

The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

ABOUT THE JOB

Most product marketers spend their careers making an average product sound better than it is. This role is the opposite.

We have built something rare: AI infrastructure that CPG teams genuinely love and will not give up. The stickiness is real, and category leaders keep choosing us. What we have not done yet is tell the world why we are better, and that gap is wide.

Today our positioning, customer proof, and competitive story are spread thin across the team. Our product is ahead of its story, and you close that gap. You own how our products show up in the market: how each area is positioned, why we win, and how we turn product and customer moments into demand. You power the GTM team with a story sharp enough to sell on, and you help define the category we are building.

This is a founding role. You are one of the first PMMs at Confido, here early enough to shape how the whole function works. Product Marketing reports to the VP of Marketing.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You own strategy, programming, and the moments: what gets said, to whom, and where. This is a role for someone who wants to make the thing, not brief it out.

- GTM enablement: the battlecards, and messaging that arm reps to win

- Case studies and customer proof, sourced, written, and deployed into Sales hands at the right moment

- An integrated plan connecting the product roadmap to the marketing calendar across lifecycle, social, partnerships, AEO, and brand moments

HOW YOU'RE MEASURED

We measure product marketing on the pipeline it moves and the deals it wins, not on activity.

- Deal velocity and win rate (primary). Sharp positioning and enablement move qualified deals faster and beat the alternatives more often

- Influenced pipeline and its trajectory. Every deal maps to one of five motions: inbound, outbound, referral, partnerships, upsell. The signal that matters most is trajectory: the share of pipeline we build rather than rent, growing over time

- Launch impact. New products are measured on adoption and the pipeline they generate, not on shipping

- Enablement effectiveness. Reps are equipped, using your assets, and able to defend against competitors in live deals

- 7+ years in product marketing. This is a clear PMM role, and we want someone who has done the craft, not an adjacent function

- Ideally in one of two worlds: CPG or commerce software, building the workflows our customers already live in, or B2B technology, where you translated genuinely complex products into clear entry points

- Financial and quantitative fluency: comfortable reporting on pipeline influence and deal velocity

Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue.

In this role, you will work closely with senior engineers, designers, and product managers to develop user-facing features and contribute to production systems. You’ll grow your iOS expertise while working on real-time, safety-critical applications that advance flight safety and operational efficiency.

What You’ll Do

- Design and implement iOS features using Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, and modern iOS frameworks.

- Work with senior engineers to build and maintain reliable, high-performance mobile applications.

- Integrate with internal and external APIs to support real-time data and application functionality.

- Collaborate with designers and product managers to deliver intuitive, user-friendly mobile experiences.

- Participate in code reviews and follow established iOS best practices and architectural patterns.

- Help ensure code quality, performance, and maintainability through testing and documentation.

What Will Make You Successful

- 9+ years of experience developing iOS applications, or equivalent experience through internships, projects, or coursework.

- Experience with Swift and SwiftUI, with some exposure to UIKit and common iOS frameworks.

- Familiarity with asynchronous programming concepts such as async/await, multithreading, or GCD.

- Basic experience working with networking, APIs, or real-world data sources.

- Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn from feedback and mentorship.

- Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, fast-moving environment.

Bonus Points

- Passion for aviation and a desire to improve air travel efficiency and safety.

- Exposure to mapping or spatial frameworks such as Mapbox or MapKit.

- Interest in real-time data, sensors, or hardware-adjacent systems.

- Familiarity with CI/CD workflows or cloud-backed mobile systems.

Work Location
This is a hybrid role based in San Carlos, CA, with 3+ days per week onsite and the option to work remotely on remaining days.

As our Director of Marketing Operations, you will own the systems, data, and insights that power marketing at Edmentum. You will lead the modernization of our marketing technology stack, bring AI and intelligent automation into how the function operates, and build the team and analytics that guide marketing investment across the company. If you love turning complex operations into a scalable, data-driven capability, this role gives you the platform to do it.

• Build, coach, and lead a talented team of marketing operations and analytics professionals

• Own the strategy and direction of our marketing technology stack, including Marketo, LeanData, Salesforce, Demandbase, Power BI, and GA4

This role owns the upstream half of that workflow: turning brand strategy, performance data, and channel diversity needs into a steady, distinctive pipeline of concepts for TikTok and emerging platforms like Pinterest and Snap. • Brand coherence at speed: Keep creatives on-strategy across multiple markets while preserving the velocity TikTok and new platforms demand.

What you’ll bring

• Sharp understanding of how TikTok's algorithm rewards native creative and creative diversity, and how that translates into briefing strategy.

title: Sales Consultant
description:
SALES CONSULTANT

THE CARWOW GROUP

Carwow Group is building the go-to destination for car-changing, reaching drivers everywhere through a portfolio of automotive brands: Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer.

Carwow started as a car reviews site and is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe, with over 10m customers helping them buy and sell cars. Our Sell My Car service lists cars for sale through a daily online auction, matching sellers with dealers who want to buy. In 2024 we acquired Autovia, doubling our audience. Our team of around 500 people across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal is revolutionising car-changing, and we are expanding across every brand and country we operate in.

WHY JOIN US?

Shortlisted in the prestigious Culture 100 list of the top Growth companies to work for by Hyer; we also recently raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify, Bessemer Venture Partners, to accelerate our growth plans! 

As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility - building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers.

Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!).

Our team of 500 employees across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal are revolutionising car-changing and we are fast expanding our mission across every single brand and country we operate in, so jump in! 

THE ROLE

As a Sales Consultant in the Sales Team, you are the main person guiding our customers into the auction and getting their car sold.

Our daily online auction can list over 1,000 cars a day, and behind every one is a seller who wants the best price and a hassle-free sale. You will take them from first conversation to sale: getting their listing right, setting realistic price expectations, then negotiating the sale to land the best price. Owning the whole journey means stronger rapport, better phone calls and fewer cancellations, and you will see the result of your work in every sale.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Manage a daily pipeline of sellers, making calls to guide each one from first conversation to a completed listing and an accepted offer, and hit daily, weekly and monthly targets.

- Review listings uploaded by sellers and work with them to fix any omissions or errors, so every car enters the auction accurately and complete.

- Explain the Carwow auction process and give honest, market-based pricing advice, so sellers feel informed and confident.

- Listen to sellers' concerns and overcome objections, using our sales frameworks.

- Negotiate on the seller's behalf to get their offer accepted at the best price the market will pay.

- Uphold our call quality standards in every interaction, so sellers have a positive experience with Carwow.

- Meet daily KPIs for call volumes, for email and text contact.

- Partner with cross-functional teams, including pre-qualification and post-sales fulfilment, sharing insight and feedback on what sellers need.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- We are looking for someone with a track record of hitting targets who is equally comfortable building rapport with a seller and negotiating confidently on their behalf.

- Previous experience in a target-driven role, with goals based on revenue or volume of sales.

- Experience managing a high-volume lead pipeline independently, with a consistent sales process and performance.

- Proven ability to negotiate and handle objections.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to build rapport with sellers from diverse backgrounds.

- Comfort working across phone, email, live chat and SMS.

- A proactive, customer-focused approach, with a genuine desire to help sellers achieve their goals.

This is a hands-on campaign planning and delivery role . You will take responsibility for assigned campaigns and activity from planning through execution, optimisation and review, using customer and market insight alongside agreed business and go-to-market priorities to inform campaign content, channels and tactics. You will contribute ideas and recommendations to campaign planning and work closely with the Senior Marketing Manager and wider teams to deliver effective, joined-up campaigns. You will work closely with colleagues across Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing, Product and other teams. Your role will include developing audience data, creating content and communications, supporting events and partnerships, briefing specialist teams and agencies, coordinating timelines and stakeholders, and using performance insight and learning to continuously improve results. Key Responsibilities

Campaign Planning & Delivery

• Plan, manage and deliver integrated, multi-channel B2B campaigns from brief through execution, optimisation and review, ensuring timely, high-quality delivery.

Partnerships & Events

• Collaborate with CRM, web, email and social teams to deliver digital campaigns, monitor performance and optimise results.

Creative, Agency & Production Management

• Develop clear creative briefs and coordinate internal teams and external agencies across design, web, social media and CRM.

• Manage campaign asset production, timelines, feedback and approvals, ensuring consistent branding and high-quality delivery.

Stakeholder Collaboration

• Build strong relationships across Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing and other teams to support campaign planning and execution.

• Coordinate stakeholders, gather requirements and share customer insights, ensuring clear responsibilities, timelines and effective collaboration.

Performance Measurement & Optimisation

• Monitor campaign performance against agreed KPIs, producing reports, insights and recommendations for stakeholders.

•

Delivery quality & collaboration: Consistent, time

title: Staff Pharmacist - Evernorth - Remote - Per Diem (Remote Order Verification)
description:
Part-Time / Per Diem Remote Staff Pharmacist

Location: Remote, anywhere within the United States

Schedule: Part-time/per diem evening, overnight, and weekend coverage, including rotating weekends, on-call coverage, and holidays. Hours vary based on staffing needs.

Licensure Requirements: Active, unrestricted pharmacist license in the state of residence required; Illinois licensure preferred. Willingness to obtain and maintain additional licenses in Iowa, Nebraska, Hawaii, and other states as needed. Pharmacists must hold an active license in each required state before providing coverage.

About the Role

Join our telepharmacy team to support hospitals across multiple states through remote medication order review, clinical consultation, and transitions-of-care services. You’ll apply clinical expertise, navigate multiple electronic medical records and pharmacy systems, and collaborate with healthcare teams to promote safe medication use and optimal patient outcomes.
We’re looking for a pharmacist who takes personal accountability for the care they provide, communicates effectively, and works independently while remaining responsive to clients and fellow team members.

What You’ll Do

Telepharmacy & Clinical Services

• Evaluate prescriber orders for safety, efficacy, and appropriateness across multiple electronic medical records and pharmacy systems.

• Perform remote medication order entry, verification, and transitions-of-care medication reconciliation.

• Review dosing, renal and hepatic adjustments, allergies, drug interactions, therapeutic duplication, and compatibilities.

• Collaborate with physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to clarify orders, resolve medication concerns, and recommend optimal therapy consistent with applicable standards and client protocols.

• Provide timely drug information and therapeutic guidance to support safe medication practices.

• Provide medication education, as applicable to assigned services, including proper use, potential side effects, and expected outcomes.

• Apply clinical knowledge to the needs of patients across the lifespan, from neonates through geriatrics, including pregnant and nursing patients and those with renal or hepatic impairment.

• Maintain working knowledge of hospital therapies, including but not limited to IV medications, cardiac and narcotic infusions, and IV antibiotics.

Communication & Operational Excellence

• Accurately and promptly document completed tasks, medication-related interventions, and clinical recommendations in designated order management and clinical systems.

• Build effective working relationships with contracted hospitals, healthcare teams, and fellow pharmacists.

• Coordinate client coverage, communicate workload needs, and assist teammates as priorities shift.

• Monitor assigned order queues and team communications to support timely processing and follow-up.

• Follow applicable pharmacy laws, professional standards, HIPAA requirements, and organizational and client policies.

Technology & Independent Practice

• Navigate multiple electronic medical records, pharmacy information systems, and automation platforms.

• Use Google Workspace and other applications needed for daily work.

• Troubleshoot routine access and workflow issues and escalate concerns appropriately.

• Maintain required licenses, credentials, training, and system access.

• Prioritize work across multiple hospital clients while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

Training & Performance

• Complete required onboarding and ongoing clinical, system, and policy training.

• Stay current with client workflows, medication safety practices, and operational updates.

• Meet established quality, productivity, and turnaround-time expectations.

• Participate in evening, overnight, rotating weekend, on-call, and holiday coverage as assigned.

Qualifications

• Bachelor of Science in Pharmacy or Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree required; PharmD prefer

title: Financial Accountant

We are seeking a hands-on, detail-oriented Financial Accountant who will play a critical role in driving operational financial excellence, compliance, and insight across our global operations. This role is ideal for a proactive, systems-savvy finance professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment takes pride in accurate, audit-ready numbers, is confident navigating modern finance systems, and is committed to continuous improvement in accounting processes.
The Financial Accountant will own Tydeco's transactional accounting and month-end balance sheet integrity across our South African and US entities, with a particular focus on consulting services revenue: client retainers, deferred and unbilled revenue, timesheet billing and revenue recognition under IFRS 15 and ASC 606. The role works closely with project, sales and operations teams to make sure that what is delivered is billed, and that what is billed is recognised and reconciled correctly.
The ideal candidate is highly analytical, a strong communicator, and thrives when given ownership and autonomy. If this is you, we invite you to apply.
As a platinum Sage partner, Tydeco and our partner entity Tydeco U specialize in delivering cutting-edge ERP solutions such as Sage Intacct and Sage 300 Cloud, and HRP solutions such as Sage VIP and SBCPP. We also offer Outsourced Accounting solutions to help clients streamline financial operations and scale with confidence. Our dedication to innovation, excellence, and client success ensures businesses not only adopt our solutions but thrive in competitive markets. Global Support

• Collaborate with international stakeholders, adjusting to varying schedules and priorities as needed.

• Maintain flexibility in scheduling to accommodate time-sensitive tasks and cross-regional collaboration.

• Manage general ledger activities including journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, and adjustments, applying the correct Sage Intacct dimensions (entity, location, department, class and project).

• Perform monthly and year-end close procedures and ensure deadlines are met across financial cycles.

title: Operations & Strategy Manager - Energy Markets
description:
OPERATIONS & STRATEGY MANAGER

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)

 

OUR MISSION FOR YOU

European energy costs are twice as high as in the US and China, and electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. This puts European industry under massive cost pressure - and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that brings together energy procurement, energy management and the marketing of flexible assets in one product. This helps companies save up to 30% on their recurring electricity costs while switching to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast - the market window is open and we intend to own it.

Now we are looking for an Operations & Strategy Manager to own a business-critical part of our energy value chain: the processes behind how we configure, price and quote long-term energy products for our customers.

 

ABOUT TRAWA

trawa is a tech-driven scale-up based in Berlin with around 100 employees, combining deep energy market expertise with in-house software development. We've raised over €35M to date, most recently a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic and Tiny VC. This role is based in our Berlin office, where we work together in person most of the week. We offer flexible working hours, so you can shape your day in a way that works for you.

 

THE TEAM

You'll join our Energy & Trading team, which owns the energy side of our business - from sourcing and portfolio management to making sure our customers' energy products work in practice. You'll report directly to our Energy & Trading Manager and work closely with the COO, our Trading Team, Sales, Pricing, Product and Tech. You start without direct reports, but with a clear mandate: own our CPQ process end-to-end and grow the margin it generates.

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Strong quantitative skills: You think analytically, feel at home with numbers and data and can confidently challenge quantitative results - without having to be a quant or developer yourself. Ideally, you have a degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g. economics, engineering, industrial engineering, business administration).

- Business acumen & process mindset: You think commercially, care about margins and unit economics, enjoy turning messy processes into robust, scalable ones and prioritise by impact. Experience with commercial processes such as pricing or deal desks, in energy, financial services or any other industry, is a plus.

- Interest in energy markets: You are fascinated by how energy markets work - from wholesale and forward markets to PPAs, hedging and pricing - and want to dive deep into them. - Hungry & ambitious: You want to grow fast, take on responsibility early and set high standards for yourself. You don't wait for instructions and enjoy a steep learning curve, and work experience in a high-paced environment, e.g. a start-up, scale-up or consulting, is a plus.

- High ownership & structured execution: You drive topics end-to-end, align stakeholders across departments and turn ideas into scalable processes with tangible business impact. An affinity for AI-powered tools and automation to make processes faster and smarter is a plus.

- Strong communication: You speak German at native level and very good English, and you translate confidently between commercial, quantitative and operational perspectives.

title: Administration Assistant (NDIS) - Payroll, Rostering and Finance Administration
description:
About the Company

Our client is an NDIS provider, established in 2022, preparing to become a registered provider and delivering core support and capacity building to around 120 participants with a team of around 45 to 50 staff. They are looking for one dedicated, full-time Administration Assistant to take over the repeatable, process-driven administration currently handled by the management team, so the team can stay focused on participants, staff and growing the business.

About the Role

This is a hands-on administration role centred on payroll preparation, finance administration, rostering support and compliance documentation. You will work in Xero, the client's rostering system (ShiftCare) and a custom-built CRM, follow documented processes exactly, and prepare work for review and approval by the Operations and Administration Manager. The role does not approve payments or pay runs. It prepares, checks and flags. It also prepares standard documents and contracts from approved templates and maintains the policy and procedure register, without changing template terms or policy content.

The role suits a careful, procedure-driven administrator with solid Australian payroll and Xero experience, who reports anomalies instead of correcting them silently, and who handles personal and confidential information with care. Attention to detail is the top priority, along with a teachable, collaborative approach to learning the client's way of working. A healthcare or nursing background is not required; a background in bookkeeping, information management or program administration is what matters, and NDIS awareness is favourable. The final task list will be confirmed with the client through a task transfer exercise, and the role will grow as processes are documented and handed over, with additional tasks within the scope of the role (for example, preparing staff training documents) added over time.

In practice, shift adjustments, roster changes and CRM administration are expected to take more daily time than payroll itself. Payroll, billing and invoicing form a concentrated block of work in each pay cycle (indicatively around one working day), alongside roughly an hour a day of ongoing bookkeeping and an hour a day of shift management. These are indicative estimates, to be confirmed in the task transfer. Training will be provided through guided walkthroughs by the Operations and Administration Manager.

Primary Purpose

To give the client's management team accurate, well-checked payroll and finance administration, an up-to-date and clash-free roster, organised compliance and recruitment records, accurate documents prepared from approved templates, a well-maintained policy and procedure register, accurate shift and billing records, and a reliable daily update on what has been done and what is next.

Payroll Preparation

• Prepare pay runs in Xero for approval, applying award-based pay rates, overtime, penalty rates, superannuation and leave entitlements

• Check timesheets against rosters before each pay run, and report any differences, gaps or unusual entries to the approver rather than correcting them silently

• Prepare and check payroll only: the role does not approve or process payments, and brings any discrepancy to management's attention

• Manage the invoicing workflow end to end, including creating, sending and tracking invoices, completed after payroll because errors are harder to correct on NDIS invoices than on pay

• Check that NDIS billing details, rates and line items are correct before invoices are issued, recognising that NDIS billing and

• Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering

• Electrical and Computer Engineering

• Electronics and Embedded Systems

• Chemical and Process Engineering

• Civil and Structural Engineering

• Manufacturing and Industrial Engineering

• Robotics and Controls

• Energy Systems

• Biomedical Engineering

Public Proof of Technical Expertise

• Complex engineering failures personally diagnosed.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
WHO WE ARE

Aurelius is the autonomous directed energy company.

We are a group of engineers, operators, and company patriots building American-made, laser-based, counter-UAS defense systems that neutralize aerial threats.

We're a small team that designs in San Francisco, manufactures in Detroit, and field tests Archimedes, our fiber-laser counter-UAS system, weekly on our own 400-acre private range.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You'll own the path from R&D to production across the whole system, and run the engineering org that executes it.

This is the person who turns a demonstrator into a weapon system. You'll lead across software, firmware, controls, hardware integration, and test, and drive the handoff from a lab system to one that survives downrange and can be built at volume. You set technical direction, and you stay close enough to be useful in the lab and on the range.

As a Director of Engineering you will set technical direction, stand up the R&D to production transition, and build the team that delivers field-ready systems at volume. You'll work daily with the technical leads, manufacturing in Detroit, and the programs team that sits with customers.

MUST-HAVES

- Significant leadership of multi-disciplinary technical teams, with a track record taking complex hardware and software systems from R&D through production or field deployment

- You can earn the respect of specialists across software, controls, and hardware even if you are not the deepest person in every domain

- Demonstrated ability to scale teams and turn ambiguity into high-performing execution

- Comfort operating hands-on in a lab and on a test range, not just in planning tools

- U.S. citizenship (required for export control).

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Priority deliverables in the first 6 months:

- A clear technical direction and authority architecture across software, firmware, controls, hardware integration, and test

- The R&D to production plan: what has to be true for subsystems to be field-ready and manufacturable, with owners and dates

- Field test leadership for upcoming range campaigns, from test article design through scoring system performance in non-lab conditions

- A hiring and team structure plan for the engineering org, and the first key seats filled or in late stages

- A working interface with programs and customers so mission requirements turn into engineering execution, not a pile of tickets

NICE TO HAVES

It would help if…

- Directed energy or high energy laser weapon system experience

- Experience standing up engineering processes and tooling for a scaling org

- Track record of hiring and growing senior technical talent

- Active security clearance or ability to obtain one.

NOT A FIT IF

- You're a people leader who has stepped away from the technical work and would not be useful in the lab or on the range

- You've only managed a single discipline, or you've never taken a system through production or field deployment

- You need remote or hybrid work

HOW WE WORK

At Aurelius we work what we call, 5+X. Our core operating hours are 5 days a week, Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm Pacific Time.

The X is the honest acknowledgment that hard work sometimes takes more. For engineering, that means late nights and weekends during sprints and ramp-up periods.

For growth, ops, and support, it means conferences, deployments, and events when the mission calls for it.

This role is onsite 5 days a week in San Francisco.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
Position Type: Full-Time | Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
About the Role
We’re looking for a proactive Sales Development Representative (SDR) to generate and qualify new business opportunities. You’ll focus on outbound prospecting, lead qualification, and consistent follow-up while helping position IT and cybersecurity services to business decision-makers.
This role is ideal for someone who is confident on the phone, comfortable with outbound sales, and understands how managed IT and cybersecurity services are sold.
Key Responsibilities
Outbound Prospecting

• Identify and research potential business clients.

• Conduct cold calls, email outreach, and LinkedIn prospecting.

• Build and maintain a consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities.

Lead Qualification

• Conduct discovery conversations with prospects.

• Understand their business needs, challenges, budget, and decision-making process.

• Qualify opportunities before handing them to the closing team.

IT & Cybersecurity Positioning

• Clearly communicate the value of IT and cybersecurity services.

• Tailor messaging based on each prospect’s business needs.

• Develop a strong understanding of MSP offerings and the problems they solve.

CRM & Pipeline Management

• Accurately log calls, emails, notes, and prospect activity.

• Keep contact records and pipeline stages updated.

• Maintain accurate visibility into outbound performance.

Follow-Up & Outreach Cadences

• Manage structured follow-up sequences across phone, email, and LinkedIn.

• Maintain consistent and professional communication with prospects.

• Follow up persistently while maintaining a positive prospect experience.

Collaboration with Sales Team

• Provide closers/account executives with detailed prospect information.

• Ensure qualified leads are handed off with relevant context and next steps.

• Participate in transition calls when needed.

Required Experience & Skills

• Experience in sales development, inside sales, or business development .

• Experience selling technology, IT services, cybersecurity, or managed services is strongly preferred.

• Familiarity with the MSP industry and how IT/cybersecurity services are positioned.

• Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

• Comfortable conducting phone conversations with business decision-makers.

• Experience using a CRM and following structured sales outreach cadences.

• Strong prospecting, qualification, follow-up, and objection-handling skills.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

• Comfortable managing daily activity and performance targets.

Perfect Fit / Culture

• Resilient and comfortable with rejection.

• Curious and focused on understanding genuine customer pain points.

• Takes ownership of activity and results.

• Communicates proactively and flags blockers early.

• Disciplined with outreach, follow-up, and CRM management.

• Comfortable working independently while collaborating with the wider sales team.

Typical Day
You’ll begin by reviewing your outreach queue and prioritizing accounts based on engagement and sales potential. Most of your day will involve outbound calls, personalized emails, LinkedIn outreach, and follow-ups with prospective customers.
Between outreach blocks, you’ll update CRM records, document conversations, qualify opportunities, and prepare qualified leads for handoff to the closing team. You’ll also participate in brief sales check-ins to align on priorities and pipeline activity.
